title: Request proposed by an agent
description: What an implementer or the Slack agent drops into the supervisor inbox. The policy decides whether it runs, waits for an approver, or is refused.

action.description: Classified by the policy as routine, prepare_only, protected or forbidden. Unclassified actions are protected.

requester.description: A role, never a person: implementer, slack-agent, orchestrator.

payload.description: Action-specific input. A request never supplies a command line; handlers only accept names and versions.
